entities.summary: Pannalal Ghosh, also known as Amal Jyoti Ghosh, was an Indian flute (bansuri) player and composer. He was a disciple of Allauddin Khan, and is credited with popularising the flute as a concert instrument in Hindustani classical music and also the "Pioneer of Indian Classical Flute".
